detail.longDescription: We spent weeks debating whether to add points, badges, and streaks to the app. It is the standard playbook for productivity tools to gamify the experience. But we realized that chasing a streak is just another form of procrastination. We decided to build an open loop tied to actual decisions instead of vanity metrics. # omnicanvasnotes # digitalworkspace # productivity # gamification # mindfulproductivity # appdevelopment
